name: WebPuzzle
description: A benchmark for evaluating information seeking on the live internet, including both wiki and open-domain queries, designed to test adaptive search intensity scaling in reinforcement learning frameworks for LLMs.
reputation: A niche live-web QA benchmark with limited but growing use in research on adaptive retrieval and information-seeking agents.
notes: Includes 24k training and 275 test samples; evaluates real-web information seeking and adaptive search policies.
